method: Assistant qualitative inspection, unblinded to model scores, using 26 retained prior full-text reviews and 24 targeted context/lexical inspections. Judgments concern the named focus, not all labels or a human accuracy estimate. No lyric excerpts are stored. Eight fixed-song sensitivity probes supplement interpretation. Plausible means compatible with inspected evidence; questionable includes construct ambiguity, truncation or insufficient evidence; clearly_wrong marks an obvious mismatch for the named intended lyrical-content construct.
